verdict.rationale: Stacked pull requests are a fair question for a Git forge like Gitea. The evidence only documents a general Pull Request/AGit review-and-merge workflow and issue dependencies. Nothing shows splitting a change into a stack, per-member readiness tracking, or ordered stack merging, and issue dependencies are an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can split a large change into stacked pull requests, see each member's readiness, and merge the stack in order
